title: Profil CTO Tunaya: “AI Innovator of the Year”

images.alt: Profil Abil Sudarman sebagai Chief Technology Officer Tunaya dengan kalimat AI Innovator of the Year disorot

shows: Profil “Abil Sudarman, Chief Technology Officer (CTO)” yang menyebut Responsible AI Fellow di Stimson Center, Executive Director KORIKA, memimpin UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment, dan dianugerahi penghargaan “AI Innovator of the Year” (disorot).
